messages:
Jules (sales): Opalescent POC kickoff. Prospect wants a reproducible perf run + hosted vs reserved pricing. Targets: p95 <= 205ms, p99 <= 370ms at sustained 28 qps, with three 40s microbursts to 100 qps. Mixed payload: 55% short (~30 tokens), 30% medium (~140 tokens), 15% long (~420 tokens). KV cache expected, ~58% prefix hit. Need run plan, infra rec, and cost scenarios by Tue EOD. cc @Clara @Ravi

Ravi (SE): Quick clarifiers: single-region ok (us-west1)? Model preference? Cold-starts included?

Jules (sales): Single-region us-west1. Customer prefers high-quality open model; propose redwood-v1-xl (fp16) baseline, offer redwood-v1-xl-int8 as cheaper option. Cold-starts not required for this benchmark.

Ravi (SE): Draft run plan:
- Canary warm: 3m at 6 qps (verify kernel and KV behavior)
- Ramp: linear 6 -> 28 qps over 5m
- Sustain: 28 qps for 20m (collect p50/p90/p95/p99 + seq-length buckets + cache-hit tag)
- Bursts: 3 x 40s @100 qps spaced 90s apart (observe recovery time)
- Prompt mix: 55/30/15 short/med/long; simulate 58% KV prefix hits
- Repeats: run fp16 baseline, then int8 quantized for tradeoffs

Ravi (SE): k6 snippet for reproducibility (sanitized):
```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function() {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({model:'redwood-v1-xl', prompt:'<sample>'});
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', payload, {headers:{Authorization:'Bearer $TOKEN'}});
  sleep(1);
}
```

Marta (infra): Infra rec: dedicated test pool 3 x A100-80G-equivalent for headroom during bursts. Per-GPU inflight cap ~48, batch size 1 for latency targets. If cost sensitivity is high, 2 nodes can be tried but risk higher p95 during bursts. Instrument GPU mem and tail heatmaps by seq bucket.

Ravi (SE): Measurement instrumentation: tag each request with seqlen_bucket and cache_hit boolean, export histograms (hdr) and error counts. We'll compute token counts per request to derive hosted token cost and amortized reserved infra cost.

Jules (sales): Customer also asked for hosted vs reserved vs private (on-prem) delta and quantized tradeoffs. Can we provide back-of-envelope now and final after corpus?

Ravi (SE): Rough ballpark (very rough):
- Hosted (fp16 redwood-v1-xl): ~ $0.50 per 1k tokens.
- Dedicated reserved (3-node): ~ 45-55% of hosted unit cost at sustained high util (after amortization).
- Private/on-prem: lower unit cost if they supply infra, but add ops/support and integration solaris; not ideal for quick POC.
- int8 quant: ~30-35% lower infra cost, expect +10-18ms added to p95 on medium/long prompts. We'll quantify after sample corpus.

sec-bot: Security quick summary: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS and VPC peering. Audit logs retention 90d by default; extended retention available as enterprise add-on. SOC2 report and penetration test artefacts can be provided under NDA.

Marta (infra): ops-bot: provisioning scheduled: "opalescent-poc-usw1-01" (3 nodes) reserved for 2.5h on 2025-04-14T16:00:00Z. Canary image includes latest runtime kernel; will run kernel-canary first and report any p99 regressions for long sequences.

Ravi (SE): Deliverables: runnable k6 scripts, runbook (steps + infra config + env vars), CSV histograms, tail-latency heatmap, cost spreadsheet (hosted vs reserved vs int8), and recommendation note. Target delivery: Tue EOD.

Clara (AE): Customer confirmed the slot and will upload a 1k-sample corpus for token profiling by Fri EOD. They also asked for a short recorded walkthrough after results.

Jules (sales): Perfect. Please call out risks: memory pressure on long prompts, kernel-canary p99 delta, and cache sensitivity (higher cache-hit reduces cost but may mask worst-case tail).

Ravi (SE): Will include those in the runbook. I'll post preliminary cost calc + runbook by Mon EOD.

Marta (infra): Noted. I'll attach monitoring dashboards and make sure logs (request-level) are exported to a csv for the customer.

Jules (sales): Thanks all :rocket:
